svg.title: Anatomy of a Skill
svg.desc: A Skill is a Python class with id and semantic version, registered in the SkillsRegistry, executed with a timeout; every execution writes skill.executed with lom_hash to the audit chain and a learning event. The feedback to optimizer to config version path is built but has never fired.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A program with an identity, a version, a timeout and an audit trail — not a prompt.
